sentences.text: Two retirees with the same balance, the same withdrawals and the same average return.
sentences.spoken: Two retirees with the same balance... the same withdrawals and the same average return.

sentences.text: One ran out of money in 1991.
sentences.spoken: One ran out of money... in nineteen ninety-one.

sentences.text: After inflation, stocks and bonds both lose money in 1973 and 1974.
sentences.spoken: After inflation... stocks and bonds both lose money in nineteen seventy-three and nineteen seventy-four.

sentences.text: In 1974 alone, the portfolio loses 14.7%, while prices rise 12.3%.
sentences.spoken: In nineteen seventy-four alone... the portfolio loses fourteen point seven percent... while prices rise twelve point three percent.

sentences.text: In 1966 dollars, the 1966 retiree ends 1974 with $461,000.
sentences.spoken: In nineteen sixty-six dollars... the nineteen sixty-six retiree ends nineteen seventy-four with four hundred sixty-one thousand dollars.
